scenarios.name: Exact archives and known-model closure
scenarios.supplied: Signal types, exact atlases/projectors, known finite linear dynamics, initial observables.
scenarios.learned: No unknown world model is learned in this construction.
scenarios.certified: Reconstruction, coherent transfer and smallest closed linear observable space under declared operators.
scenarios.not_certified: Accessibility or low dimension of the completed state.

scenarios.name: Output-only autonomous delay realization
scenarios.supplied: An autonomous finite linear class, sufficient delay closure and span coverage.
scenarios.learned: Transition on the realizable observation-window space from paired outputs.
scenarios.certified: Exact interpolation on the observed span; full predictive identification only under coverage.
scenarios.not_certified: Unknown global dimension, arbitrary controlled dynamics or nonlinear hidden-state discovery.

scenarios.name: Finite controlled population-table realization
scenarios.supplied: Exact history/test probabilities, rank upper bound, complete core and finite alphabets.
scenarios.learned: Observable operators; one bounded interval-domain search uses only those operators.
scenarios.certified: A checked finite positive lift establishes validity of the fitted model at all horizons.
scenarios.not_certified: Statistical truth from exact synthetic tables or a general complete cone search.

scenarios.name: Continuous polynomial tables and exact curved discovery
scenarios.supplied: Reference measure, finite predictive rank and polynomial degree, event/moment core. Initial demonstration supplies a template; later exact ellipsoid discovery uses additional structural hypotheses instead.
scenarios.learned: Population moment operators and, in the restricted exact sector, an oriented quadratic geometry.
scenarios.certified: Supplied PSD or quadratic identities preserve probability meaning on the stated domain.
scenarios.not_certified: Noisy arbitrary geometry or unrestricted unknown-degree identification.

scenarios.name: Deterministic perturbed operators and reset repair
scenarios.supplied: A fixed rational perturbed coefficient family, proposed geometry, reset path and uncertainty coordinates.
scenarios.learned: Numerical geometry proposal; subsequently a rational witness is constructed and replayed.
scenarios.certified: A smaller reset weight 1/32 has an exact domain certificate and comparison-domain error budget.
scenarios.not_certified: An empirical confidence set containing the unmodified generating process; globally optimal geometry or repair.

scenarios.name: Dependent observable five-node process
scenarios.supplied: Fixed feature map (1,u,u^2), exact five-node measure, two-parameter conditional family, prior bounds and predictable protocol.
scenarios.learned: Two scalar parameters and outward-rounded time-uniform confidence intervals.
scenarios.certified: Every member of the returned rectangle is internally valid. Conditional 95% time-uniform coverage follows from the declared stochastic model, not from one seeded path.
scenarios.not_certified: Unknown feature discovery, sensor-data authentication, continuous/discrete measure equivalence or coverage for S5.

scenarios.name: Sequential discrepancy monitoring
scenarios.supplied: Predictable bounded tests, prospectively registered budgets, known action propensities where used.
scenarios.learned: Evidence of conditional mismatch along encountered histories.
scenarios.certified: A time-uniform lower discrepancy statement when a test rejects.
scenarios.not_certified: Nonrejection as an upper accuracy bound or unvisited-action coverage.

forbidden_inference: S6 statistical coverage does not attach to S5, S3 or S4 without a separate identification and coverage argument.
